cases.purpose: Check EPERM diagnostics and unchanged foreign-owned files and directories, kernel setgid clearing for non-member groups, member-group control and mixed operands. Explicit status and mode assertions reject a shared setup or execution failure.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils chmod under uid/gid 2000 with supplementary groups cleared
cases.comparison: Compare normalized diagnostics, per-command status and modes and final fixture tree; assertions enforce the expected effects on each side.
cases.setup_script:
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 0755 fixtures fixtures/foreign-dir fixtures/other-group-dir
/usr/bin/touch fixtures/foreign fixtures/root-file fixtures/other-group fixtures/member
/usr/bin/chown 2002:3002 fixtures/foreign fixtures/foreign-dir
/usr/bin/chown 0:0 fixtures/root-file
/usr/bin/chown 2000:3002 fixtures/other-group fixtures/other-group-dir
/usr/bin/chown 2000:2000 fixtures/member
/usr/bin/chmod 0644 fixtures/foreign fixtures/root-file fixtures/other-group fixtures/member
/usr/bin/chmod 0755 fixtures/foreign-dir fixtures/other-group-dir
cases.script:
run() {
  local label=$1 command=$2 want_status=$3 path=$4 want_mode=$5 rc actual
  /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 --clear-groups -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$command" >/tmp/chmod-reg.out 2>/tmp/chmod-reg.err
  rc=$?
  actual=$(/usr/bin/stat -c %a "$path") || exit 97
  printf '%s status=%s mode=%s out=' "$label" "$rc" "$actual"
  /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' </tmp/chmod-reg.out
  printf ' err='
  /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' /tmp/chmod-reg.err | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'
  echo
  [[ $rc == "$want_status" && $actual == "$want_mode" ]] || exit 98
  if [[ $want_status != 0 ]]; then [[ -s /tmp/chmod-reg.err ]] || exit 98; else [[ ! -s /tmp/chmod-reg.err ]] || exit 98; fi
}
run foreign-file 'chmod 0600 fixtures/foreign' 1 fixtures/foreign 644
run foreign-dir 'chmod g+s fixtures/foreign-dir' 1 fixtures/foreign-dir 755
run root-file 'chmod u+x fixtures/root-file' 1 fixtures/root-file 644
run other-group-symbolic 'chmod g+s fixtures/other-group' 0 fixtures/other-group 644
run other-group-octal 'chmod 2755 fixtures/other-group' 0 fixtures/other-group 755
run other-group-dir 'chmod 2775 fixtures/other-group-dir' 0 fixtures/other-group-dir 775
run member-group 'chmod 2755 fixtures/member' 0 fixtures/member 2755
run mixed 'chmod 0640 fixtures/member fixtures/foreign fixtures/other-group' 1 fixtures/foreign 644
[[ $(/usr/bin/stat -c %a fixtures/member) == 640 && $(/usr/bin/stat -c %a fixtures/other-group) == 640 ]] || exit 98
